description: AICTIONBOT™ buying policy by KULIC Advisory (tool 39), built on the Execution Toolkit templates T32 (operating model) and T03 (process taxonomy with RASCI). Writes a one-page buying policy for a business without a procurement department from three value limits (direct order up to small_limit, three quotes from quote_limit, managing-director approval from board_limit; defaults 1,000, 10,000 and 25,000 euros) and the name of the approver. Optionally answers the five questions for one purchase (purchase_value, purchase_type goods, service, capital purchase, software or consulting, preferred_supplier with framework agreement yes or no): how many quotes, specification, award note, contract, who approves. Optionally checks a list of orders (order, supplier, value, type, framework, quotes, specification, award note, contract, approval) against the rules, with red and yellow findings and possible order splitting. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Not legal advice. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

approver.description: Who approves above board_limit. Default managing director.

board_limit.description: Approval by the managing director from this value in euros. Default 25000.

company.description: Company name for the policy title.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

orders.description: Optional order rows: order, supplier, value, type, framework (yes/no), quotes (number), specification, award_note, contract (yes/no), approval (who approved). German column names work too.

preferred_supplier.description: Is there a preferred supplier with a framework agreement?

purchase_type.description: Type of the purchase: goods, service, capital purchase, software, consulting (German words work too).

purchase_value.description: One purchase to check: total value in euros over the whole term.

quote_limit.description: Three quotes from this value in euros. Default 10000.

small_limit.description: Order directly up to this value in euros. Default 1000.

name: write_buying_policy
title: Buying policy in five questions: value limits, number of quotes, specification, award note, contract and approval, plus a check of orders against the rules
